text: BAM share rose 1.44 percentage points over 25 hours and 1.03 percentage points over 7 days, reaching 37.0% of Solana stake. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 25% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 66 top-node leadership changes reflect whale-driven routing, not a validated structural rollover.
